name: Helmut Müller
headline: Partner @ Metaworld Fund | Ex-Roland Berger | CDTM
summary:
I am a Partner at Metaworld Fund, a fund of funds that targets outsized risk-adjusted returns in the rapidly expanding digital assets sector. I have over six years of expertise in both direct and indirect blockchain investments, including involvement in numerous ICOs, IDOs, and IEOs. I was a Visiting Scholar degree at Columbia Business School, hold a Master of Science degree in Business Administration from Technical University of Munich, and an Honors Degree in Technology Management from CDTM.

Previously, I was the CEO of æternity consulting and a Board member of æternity blockchain, where I led the development and implementation of blockchain solutions for enterprise applications. I also contributed to the successful IPO of eve sleep plc as the General Manager of Germany, Austria, and Switzerland, where I executed the market entry strategy and achieved six million yearly revenue in two years. I am passionate about leveraging my skills in financial modeling, market analysis, marketing strategy, and distributed team management to foster business growth and innovation in the e-commerce and blockchain industry.
